channel.title: Governance Digest: arbitrum
channel.description: New DAO governance proposals and discussions, summarized in plain English.

item.title: 11 November, 2026 - Roundup of Active/Upcoming Votes (arbitrum)
item.description: The 11 November roundup lists three on-chain Arbitrum proposals with voting ending November 12, including 100M ARB more for a USDG program and a 1,800 ETH treasury transfer, plus a temperature check on releasing frozen funds.

item.title: Security Council Membership Rotation - November 2026 (arbitrum)
item.description: An announcement says Immunefi's representative on the Arbitrum Security Council, who left Immunefi, will keep serving in a personal capacity after 9 of 12 members voted to allow it.

item.title: Arbitrum Audit Program: Q4 & Final Transparency Report (arbitrum)
item.description: The final report on the DAO-approved Arbitrum Audit Program says 367 applications led to 25 audits for 22 projects, at a total audit expenditure of $1,477,810.

item.title: [Constitutional] AIP: Approve Release of Frozen ETH and ARB (arbitrum)
item.description: Binance asks ArbitrumDAO to approve releasing 8,425.997 ETH and 74,559,805.2 ARB, frozen by the Arbitrum Security Council on 29 October 2026, back to a Binance recovery address.

item.title: OpCo Update October 2026 (arbitrum)
item.description: OpCo reports on October 2026 for Arbitrum DAO, covering the Oversight and Transparency Committee, USDG coordination, a negotiation over a 10M ARB set-aside, and cross-organization work.

item.title: Entropy Advisors Monthly Update: October 2026 (arbitrum)
item.description: Entropy Advisors reports on October 2026 for Arbitrum DAO: USDG supply on Arbitrum One reached $61.32M, treasury stablecoins moved toward USDG, and two onchain votes close November 12.

item.title: [Final Report] zkArb SDK - Dev Tooling on One and Stylus (D.A.O. Season 3) (arbitrum)
item.description: The zkArb SDK grantee reports all seven milestones delivered under a $13,000 Arbitrum D.A.O. Season 3 grant.

item.title: Rewarding Active Delegates - October 2026 Results (arbitrum)
item.description: Arbitrum's October 2026 delegate rewards: 28 of 32 enrolled delegates qualified and $12,000 was distributed, with 86.72% aggregate participation.

item.title: November 3, 2026 - Open Discussion of Proposals Governance Call (arbitrum)
item.description: Arbitrum's governance call on November 3, 16:00-17:00 UTC, will cover three on-chain AIPs, an off-chain Stylus Activation Contract AIP, and a Security Council emergency action.

item.title: 2 November, 2026 - Roundup of Active/Upcoming Votes (arbitrum)
item.description: Arbitrum's roundup lists on-chain votes including a 100M ARB addition to the DRIP budget for USDG adoption and a 1,800 ETH treasury transfer.

item.title: Security Council Emergency Action – 30/10/2026 (arbitrum)
item.description: The Arbitrum Security Council executed an emergency action on 30 October 2026 to freeze 8,425 ETH and 74,559,805.2 ARB on Arbitrum One held by an address identified with a Binance exploit.

item.title: [Constitutional] AIP: Stylus Activation Contract (arbitrum)
item.description: A Constitutional AIP would resume Stylus contract activations on Arbitrum One with a new activation contract, delegating activation signatures to an Arbitrum Foundation multisig for contracts that pass a limited security audit.

item.title: 27 October, 2026 - Roundup of Active/Upcoming Votes (arbitrum)
item.description: Roundup lists three upcoming Arbitrum on-chain proposals, all with voting starting October 29: a USDG initiative with 100M ARB for DRIP, a 1,800 ETH treasury transfer, and L1-pricing parameter updates for Glamsterdam.

item.title: Atomic Launchpad: a token launchpad going live on Arbitrum One (arbitrum)
item.description: Timeus Lab introduces Atomic Launchpad, a bonding-curve token launchpad it planned to deploy on Arbitrum One on the night of October 26-27, and asks delegates what support they would consider. No funding is requested.
